part_1_ruling.contrast_with_the_two_prior_windows: the first failed with 127 failed runs and a deadlocked watermark; the second lost three fire events to scheduler stalls; this one lost nothing.

part_2_the_remediation_was_not_actually_.finding: This window passed WITHOUT the misfire grace ever being needed. That must be stated plainly rather than left for a reader to assume otherwise.
evidence: every one of the 189 slots fired on its 10-minute boundary; the largest start offset in the whole window is 13 seconds

the stall signature that killed window two is present again: 18 gaps of 1 to 3 minutes in the per-minute snapshot job, clustered around CST midday and evening, including a 6-minute compound stall on 2026-08-17 from 11:50 to 11:56 CST

not one of those stalls crossed a news_poll slot boundary. The 11:50 to 11:56 stall fell in the empty span between the 11:30 and 12:00 slots; the 18:18 to 18:26 stall on 2026-08-13 fell between the 18:00 and 18:30 slots
part_2_the_remediation_was_not_actually_.what_this_means: the 600-second grace is in force and correct by review and by test, but this window provides no field evidence that it rescues a slot, because no stall landed on one. The window passed on a favourable stall distribution as much as on the fix. The fix remains the right change; its production proof is still outstanding and will come the first time a stall crosses a slot start.
part_2_the_remediation_was_not_actually_.not_a_reason_to_fail: the gate is slot completeness, not fix exercise. Demanding a demonstrated rescue would be inventing a new gate after the fact, which this regime does not do.

part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.observed: under the selected-only raw view, four flags read false: all_pass, cninfo_checkpoint_contract_ok, cninfo_daily_slice_checkpoint_contract_ok and source_accounting_ok, all traceable to JobRun 88234
part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.what_88234_is: the 2026-08-17 00:00 CST slot, the first slot of window day three, which follows a weekend the window deliberately skips
reviewer_verified_root_cause: 88234's checkpoint before is verified_checkpoint_date_shanghai 2026-08-15, which equals the after of JobRun 88203, the 2026-08-16 23:30 CST slot that ran normally outside the window. The chain is unbroken in real time; it only looks broken when the immediately preceding slot is excluded from the selected set
newest_observed_at_utc advances from 2026-08-14T16:00Z to 2026-08-16T16:00Z, so nothing is retrograde

88234 inserted 159 rows carrying weekend availability; the database holds 2,083 rows dated 2026-08-15 CST and 141 dated 2026-08-16 CST, none of which belongs to any window day. Accounting that sums only the three window dates therefore cannot balance against slots that legitimately carry weekend rows
part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.ruling: ACCEPTED AS A BOUNDARY ARTEFACT, NOT A DATA DEFECT. The checkpoint and accounting contracts are defined over continuous time; the window is deliberately non-contiguous. Slicing a continuous stream by three chosen dates necessarily breaks the join at the first slot of any day that follows an excluded day.
part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.purpose_form_view_approved: the report's full-calendar lineage bridge, 285 chain nodes with zero issues, restores the real predecessor and is approved as a correction to a defective gate boundary, not as a relaxation. It changes no threshold, admits no failing slot and repairs no data; it only stops treating an excluded neighbour as if it did not exist.
part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.C-8_reviewer_error_recorded: the boundary defect is the reviewer's. The verdict at d37395d prescribed a non-contiguous window without amending the checkpoint and accounting contracts, which assume contiguity. Any future window must declare its boundary-predecessor rule in advance rather than have one supplied after the numbers are in.
part_3_three_raw_gate_falses_adjudicated.preservation_order: the four raw false flags stay in the record permanently. No future report may present only the purpose-form view; both must appear together with this adjudication cited.

part_4_provenance_W5_closed.constraint_held: the scheduler ran the entire window on one process, PID 9978, started 2026-08-13 18:26 CST, with zero additional restarts. The reviewer confirmed the PID, its start time and the byte digests of all five scheduler-imported files against the baseline captured on 2026-08-15; every digest is unchanged.
part_4_provenance_W5_closed.disclosure_required_by_the_owner_decisio: the scheduler executes worktree bytes through an editable install. jobs/registry.py, the common job wrapper, carried an uncommitted change made 2026-08-13 14:51 CST, and the process serving this window loaded it at 18:26 CST. Every dirty imported file's mtime precedes the process start, so days two and three are homogeneous and only day one contains a mid-day provenance change at 18:26 CST.
part_4_provenance_W5_closed.measured_effect: nil for news_poll. The change wraps each job body in a baostock session scope that, for a job never touching baostock, sets and resets a ContextVar and does nothing on exit; its lock acquisition is non-blocking. The reviewed misfire_grace_time field and its validation are intact in the running bytes.
part_4_provenance_W5_closed.W3_correction_stands: the earlier claim that the respawned scheduler was verified to be running post-merge code was insufficient and was corrected on 2026-08-15; it is not restated here as fact.
part_4_provenance_W5_closed.standing_rule: for any future acceptance window, capture and re-verify the byte digests of every scheduler-imported file at window start and after any restart. Under an editable install, a path check is not a provenance check.

part_5_other_window_observations.W-4_backup_early_run: the 2026-08-13 backup executed at 18:15 CST against a module window that opens at 22:00. Mechanism unresolved, operations-side, outside the P4.1 gates. The 2026-08-14 backup completed normally at 22:03:54 CST.
part_5_other_window_observations.other_jobs_failing_inside_the_window: compute_factors and reconcile_prediction_outputs failed 20 times each between 2026-08-13 00:00 and 09:52 CST, plus one evaluate_alerts and one sync_adj_factors on 2026-08-14. All four are designed fail-closed refusals: factor input coverage below the 90 percent safety threshold, a downstream job declining to run without upstream factors, and two waits that timed out rather than computing on incomplete inputs. None is a news_poll slot, none writes bad data, none is inside the P4.1 gates. Recorded for system health, not for this verdict.
part_5_other_window_observations.coverage_recovered: the factor coverage shortfall cleared by itself at 09:52 CST on 2026-08-13 and both jobs have run normally since.
